js: const C=QCAT.Calib, S=QCAT.Save.d; const before=JSON.stringify([S.unlock,S.reached,Object.keys(S.obs||{}).length]); C.toggle(); C.panel(true); const chip=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.trim()==='Unlock everything'); chip.click(); const mid=JSON.stringify([S.unlock.endless,Object.keys(QCAT.Save.d.obs||{}).length]); const undo=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/Undo unlock/.test(b.textContent)); undo.click(); const S2=QCAT.Save.d; JSON.stringify({before, mid, after: JSON.stringify([S2.unlock,S2.reached,Object.keys(S2.obs||{}).length]), undoFound: !!undo})
